title: 32 full production RUN CARD prompts + control Router v2

source_provenance.locator: 2026-08-21 directive: develop each of the 32 next-step prompts and determine what follows
source_provenance.notes: Direct Founder continuation of Self-Improvement v2

problem_or_opportunity: The v1 32-run-card outline identified the right stages but was not sufficiently executable: each stage needed explicit inputs, execution algorithm, Red Team, required outputs, PASS/FAIL gate and auto-continuation; manual prompt selection would still create Founder routing burden.
proposed_mechanism: Thirty-two full production prompt contracts organized around P1 Book, P2 Book-to-Audio, Factory/Engines/Productivity and Research/Self-Improvement, plus Prompt 33 A00 Router that selects the smallest applicable prompt from CURRENT state, permits only safe independent parallelism and recomputes the next route after PASS.
expected_benefit: Turns Self-Improvement v2 from policy into a repeatable production operating layer while reducing manual 'which prompt next?' decisions and preventing lower-priority meta-work from starving books/audio.

acceptance_conditions: Router chooses smallest correct prompt from persisted state
prompt does not restart solved work
outputs are consumable by downstream stage
auto-continue stops only at a real gate
parallel routes are dependency-independent and rebase before write

red_team_findings: Do not promote because the prompt text is comprehensive; it needs real workflow pilots.
Do not fire all 32 prompts as a checklist.
Prompt 33 must remain a router, not a new creative authority.
The full pack should eventually compile to machine routing/state contracts rather than remain manual prose only.
owner_role: A00 Router / Prompt Architect / Self-Improvement Reconciler
next_action: Build executable Prompt Router state machine/schema, then run four bounded pilots beginning with the next real P1 book workflow rather than a synthetic demonstration.
notes: Standalone candidate record created immediately to prevent prompt-pack loss. Next registry sweep should semantic-dedupe and merge it into CURRENT_IMPROVEMENT_REGISTRY.json rather than create a duplicate candidate.
